subject.title: fix(channels): honor configured read target policies

question: Should PR #99905 land as the broad fail-closed channel read authorization fix, including signed current-turn context propagation and Google Chat reaction action removal?
rationale: The patch appears to repair the right security boundary, but it changes compatibility-sensitive behavior across several bundled channel plugins and adds public plugin context surface, so maintainer intent is required before merge.

options.title: Land After Green Gate Refresh
options.body: Accept the stricter authorization model once the exact-head CI failure is refreshed and treat the Google Chat reaction no-op as intentional compatibility behavior.

options.title: Require Representative Upgrade Proof
options.body: Hold merge until maintainers get fresh-install and upgrade proof for allowed current-conversation and configured cross-conversation reads across representative Matrix, MSTeams, Feishu, and Google Chat setups.

options.title: Split Google Chat Reaction Removal
options.body: Ask the author to separate Google Chat reaction action removal from the read-authorization hardening if maintainers want the security fix with less action-surface churn.

recommendation.title: Land After Green Gate Refresh
recommendation.body: Accept the stricter authorization model once the exact-head CI failure is refreshed and treat the Google Chat reaction no-op as intentional compatibility behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across the plugin SDK/context and channel runtime boundaries this decision affects.
